eve: Quick sync — proposing a micro-onboard for 3 legacy tenants next sprint. Need bench slice, pin TTL, and rollback escape hatch.
marc (pm): micro-bench proposal: 5 representative prompts per tenant, p50/p95 latency, token-cost per 1k, and a single human qual smoke. Keep run <=90s per model. Fail -> hold canary.
jun (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: add KV cache-warm step, streaming toggle, and embedding-schema compatibility check. Pin API endpoint: /admin/catalog/pin with ttl and audit log. Add per-tenant flag to opt-out of auto-fallback.
eve: Rollout waves: 1) internal QA, 2) two low-traffic tenants, 3) remaining tenant if stable. Gate = bench pass + 6h observation with error rate <2% and no latency regressions in traces.
ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: onboard-canary-179999 at 2026-01-07T09:00Z (CI: https://ci.redwood/onboard/179999).
marc (pm): Action items: jun -> pin API + embed-check spec by Tue EOD; eve -> customer wave list + comms by Wed; I'll loop in finance/legal re: gracepath pricing.
eve: Keep bench slice tiny and automatable so we can move fast. Meeting check Friday 10am to surface blockers. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
